name: Iede Musumegari ~Usotsuki Kami-sama~
original_name: 家出娘狩り～嘘つき神様～
source:
Azusa was a girl with a very short temper. One day she lost it and ran away.
It was poorly planned. With nowhere to go she instantly fell victim to the harsh truths of survival.
